posts.title: I miss my Sunday morning coffee
posts.description: The fight for our attention has turned into a scream fest. The old fix was a weekly periodical and a slow Sunday. Building your own comes with a trap.

posts.title: LeetCode is your gym now
posts.description: We're supposed to stop writing code by hand and let the agents do it. Fine. But if you never build a system yourself, you lose the one thing that lets you tell when the machine gets it wrong.

posts.title: GenAI will kill OnlyFans, and maybe the Internet
posts.description: AI-generated fake influencers and content will erode the trust that makes social platforms valuable — and drive people back to each other.
